decisions.od10: TargetScope is additive optional. Absence preserves exact historical single-repository semantics, is never interpreted as all components, and historical records are never backfilled.
decisions.od11: Task ownership remains ownerGovernedSessionId plus the exact component subset in TargetScope. Equal intent keys on disjoint component scopes remain independent.
decisions.projectSha: FORBIDDEN: TargetContext carries independent per-component githubHead/runtimeRevision; no project SHA is synthesized.

invariants: GitRegistry V2 remains the project/component authority; no second project registry.
Operational Memory remains the session/task/lock authority; no second state store.
Live State remains the observation authority; TargetContext is optional inside the same snapshot.
TargetScope contains identity/ownership only and never SHA authority.
A missing TargetScope means only the historical single repository, never every project component.
Unresolved component evidence stays local to that component.
Component lock scopes are minimal and independent.
BootstrapReceipt with explicit multi-component TargetScope stores scoped TargetContext and leaves legacy githubHead/runtimeRevision null.
TargetContext observedAt alone does not increment Live State stateVersion.
